description: Incyte Corporation is a global biopharmaceutical company engaged in the discovery, development and commercialization of proprietary therapeutics, with global headquarters in Wilmington, Delaware where it conducts discovery, clinical development and commercial operations, and also conducting clinical development and commercial operations from its European headquarters in Morges, Switzerland, its other offices across Europe, its Japanese headquarters in Tokyo and its Canadian headquarters in Montreal. It is focused in three therapeutic areas defined by the indications of its approved medicines and the diseases for which its clinical candidates are being developed: Hematology, Oncology, and Inflammation and Autoimmunity, and its hematology franchise includes four approved products, JAKAFI (ruxolitinib), ICLUSIG (ponatinib), MONJUVI (tafasitamab-cxix)/MINJUVI (tafasitamab) and NIKTIMVO (axatilimab-csfr), as well as multiple clinical development programs.
